with resolved as (
  select
    er.id as raw_event_id,
    er.received_at,
    er.source_system,
    er.event_type,
    er.location_id,
    er.location_name,
    er.contact_id,
    er.phone,
    er.email,
    er.payload,

    cb.id as client_id,
    cb.client_name,
    cb.ghl_location_id,
    cb.status as client_status,
    cb.timezone

  from public.events_raw er

  left join public.clients_base cb
    on cb.ghl_location_id = coalesce(
      er.payload->'normalized'->>'ghl_location_id',
      er.payload->'normalized'->>'location_id',
      er.location_id
    )

  where er.id = '{{ $("Insert Raw Event").first().json.id }}'::uuid
  limit 1
),
log_update as (
  update public.workflow_execution_logs l
  set
    client_id = r.client_id,
    client_name = r.client_name,
    ghl_location_id = coalesce(r.ghl_location_id, r.location_id),
    stage = case
      when r.client_id is not null then 'client_resolved'
      else 'client_not_found'
    end,
    metadata = coalesce(l.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      'client_found', r.client_id is not null,
      'client_id', r.client_id,
      'client_name', r.client_name,
      'ghl_location_id', coalesce(r.ghl_location_id, r.location_id)
    ),
    stages = coalesce(l.stages, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      'client_resolution', jsonb_build_object(
        'status', case when r.client_id is not null then 'resolved' else 'not_found' end,
        'client_id', r.client_id,
        'client_name', r.client_name,
        'at', now()
      )
    )
  from resolved r
  where l.id = NULLIF(
    '{{ String($("Log Abertura 1.1").first().json.workflow_log_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
    ''
  )::uuid
    and l.status = 'running'
  returning l.id
)
select r.*
from resolved r
left join log_update lu on true
limit 1;

with input as (
  select
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.normalized_event_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')::uuid as normalized_event_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.raw_event_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '')::uuid as raw_event_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.ghl_location_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as ghl_location_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.contact_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as contact_id,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.event_code ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as event_code,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.platform ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as platform,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.route ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as route,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.meta_event_name ?? $json.platform_event_name ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as meta_event_name,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.payload ?? $json.outbox_payload ?? {}).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb as payload,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.status ?? $json.outbox_status ?? "pending").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as status,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.last_error ?? $json.outbox_last_error ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as last_error,
    {{ $json.should_create_outbox === true ? 'true' : 'false' }}::boolean as should_create_outbox,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.routing_decision_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as routing_decision_status,
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.routing_reason ?? $json.last_error ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') as routing_reason
),
updated as (
  update public.conversion_outbox co
  set
    ghl_location_id = i.ghl_location_id,
    contact_id = i.contact_id,
    event_code = i.event_code,
    payload = i.payload,
    status = case
      when co.status = 'sent' then co.status
      else i.status
    end,
    last_error = case
      when co.status = 'sent' then co.last_error
      else i.last_error
    end,
    next_attempt_at = case
      when co.status = 'sent' then co.next_attempt_at
      else now()
    end
  from input i
  where i.should_create_outbox = true
    and i.normalized_event_id is not null
    and co.normalized_event_id = i.normalized_event_id
    and co.platform = i.platform
    and co.route = i.route
    and co.meta_event_name = i.meta_event_name
  returning
    co.id as conversion_outbox_id,
    co.status as outbox_status,
    co.last_error as outbox_last_error,
    co.created_at as outbox_created_at,
    'updated'::text as outbox_action
),
inserted as (
  insert into public.conversion_outbox (
    normalized_event_id,
    ghl_location_id,
    contact_id,
    event_code,
    platform,
    route,
    meta_event_name,
    payload,
    status,
    attempts,
    response,
    last_error,
    next_attempt_at,
    created_at,
    sent_at
  )
  select
    i.normalized_event_id,
    i.ghl_location_id,
    i.contact_id,
    i.event_code,
    i.platform,
    i.route,
    i.meta_event_name,
    i.payload,
    i.status,
    0,
    null,
    i.last_error,
    now(),
    now(),
    null
  from input i
  where i.should_create_outbox = true
    and i.normalized_event_id is not null
    and not exists (select 1 from updated)
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.conversion_outbox co
      where co.normalized_event_id = i.normalized_event_id
        and co.platform = i.platform
        and co.route = i.route
        and co.meta_event_name = i.meta_event_name
    )
  returning
    id as conversion_outbox_id,
    status as outbox_status,
    last_error as outbox_last_error,
    created_at as outbox_created_at,
    'inserted'::text as outbox_action
),
result as (
  select * from updated
  union all
  select * from inserted
),
routing_result as (
select
  i.raw_event_id,
  i.normalized_event_id,
  i.event_code,
  i.platform,
  i.route,
  i.meta_event_name,
  i.should_create_outbox,
  i.routing_decision_status,
  i.routing_reason,
  coalesce(
    r.outbox_action,
    case
      when i.should_create_outbox = false then 'skipped_no_outbox_needed'
      when i.normalized_event_id is null then 'skipped_missing_normalized_event_id'
      else 'not_inserted_unknown'
    end
  ) as outbox_action,
  r.conversion_outbox_id,
  r.outbox_status,
  r.outbox_last_error,
  r.outbox_created_at
from input i
left join result r on true
limit 1
),
log_update as (
  update public.workflow_execution_logs l
  set
    stage = 'routing_decision_recorded',
    metadata = coalesce(l.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      'routing_status', rr.routing_decision_status,
      'routing_reason', coalesce(rr.routing_reason, rr.outbox_last_error),
      'conversion_outbox_id', rr.conversion_outbox_id,
      'platform', rr.platform,
      'route', rr.route,
      'outbox_status', rr.outbox_status
    ),
    stages = coalesce(l.stages, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      'routing', jsonb_build_object(
        'status', coalesce(rr.routing_decision_status, 'unknown'),
        'reason', coalesce(rr.routing_reason, rr.outbox_last_error),
        'jobs_created', case when rr.conversion_outbox_id is not null then 1 else 0 end,
        'outbox_id', rr.conversion_outbox_id,
        'platform', rr.platform,
        'route', rr.route,
        'outbox_status', rr.outbox_status,
        'at', now()
      )
    )
  from routing_result rr
  where l.id = NULLIF(
    '{{ String($("Log Abertura 1.1").first().json.workflow_log_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
    ''
  )::uuid
    and l.status = 'running'
  returning l.id
)
select rr.*
from routing_result rr
left join log_update lu on true;

update public.workflow_execution_logs
set
  status = 'success',
  stage = case
    when NULLIF('{{ String($("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.routing_decision_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'not_applicable'
      then 'completed_not_applicable'
    when NULLIF('{{ String($("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.routing_decision_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'skipped'
      then 'completed_no_conversion_route'
    when NULLIF('{{ String($("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.outbox_status ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') = 'skipped'
      then 'completed_conversion_skipped'
    when NULLIF('{{ String($("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.conversion_outbox_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', '') is not null
      then 'completed_with_conversion_job'
    else 'completed'
  end,
  finished_at = now(),
  duration_ms = (extract(epoch from (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::bigint,
  items_processed = 1,
  items_failed = 0,
  error_message = null,
  error_node = null,
  metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ||
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      processing_result: "normalized",
      normalized_event_id: $("Upsert Normalized Event").first().json.id ?? null,
      routing_status: $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.routing_decision_status ?? null,
      routing_reason: $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.routing_reason ?? $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.outbox_last_error ?? null,
      conversion_outbox_id: $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.conversion_outbox_id ?? null,
      platform: $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.platform ?? null,
      route: $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.route ?? null,
      outbox_status: $("Upsert Conversion Outbox").first().json.outbox_status ?? null
    }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb,
  stages = coalesce(stages, '{}'::jsonb) ||
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      completion: {
        status: "success",
        processing_result: "normalized",
        at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb
where id = NULLIF(
  '{{ String($("Log Abertura 1.1").first().json.workflow_log_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  ''
)::uuid
  and status = 'running'
returning
  id,
  workflow_key,
  workflow_name,
  status,
  stage,
  started_at,
  finished_at,
  duration_ms,
  metadata,
  stages;

update public.workflow_execution_logs
set
  status = 'success',
  stage = 'client_not_found_recorded',
  finished_at = now(),
  duration_ms = (extract(epoch from (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::bigint,
  items_processed = 1,
  items_failed = 0,
  error_message = null,
  error_node = null,
  metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ||
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      processing_result: "client_not_found",
      processing_reason: $json.processing_error ?? null
    }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb,
  stages = coalesce(stages, '{}'::jsonb) ||
    '{{ JSON.stringify({
      completion: {
        status: "success",
        processing_result: "client_not_found",
        reason: $json.processing_error ?? null,
        at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    }).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb
where id = NULLIF(
  '{{ String($("Log Abertura 1.1").first().json.workflow_log_id ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  ''
)::uuid
  and status = 'running'
returning
  id,
  workflow_key,
  workflow_name,
  status,
  stage,
  started_at,
  finished_at,
  duration_ms,
  metadata,
  stages;

## Observabilidade V2 — 1.1

O ciclo de log agora faz parte do caminho principal:

1. Insert Raw Event
2. Log Abertura 1.1
3. Resolução do cliente
4. Normalização
5. Decisão de roteamento
6. Fechamento por ID exato do log
7. Respond to Webhook

**Sem ramos paralelos para abrir/fechar o log.**

Resultados tratados de negócio ou plataforma não são classificados como erro técnico do n8n:

- cliente não encontrado → resultado registrado no raw; log n8n fecha com success
- evento não aplicável → routing not_applicable; log n8n fecha com success
- sem rota elegível → routing skipped; log n8n fecha com success

Erros técnicos inesperados continuam sendo capturados pelo workflow 9.9.
